corpus.clone: git clone --depth 1 <repo> chromium (then verify HEAD == commit); src only, no DEPS

answer_format: End your reply with a fenced code block tagged `answer` that contains one item per line (exactly the kind of item the question asks for) and nothing else.

questions.prompt: List every file in this repository that #includes net/http/http_response_info.h directly, with any include spelling. Search the whole tree. Answer items: repository-relative file paths.
Where is the C++ class URLRequestJob defined (the class definition with its body, not a forward declaration)? Answer item: one path:line.

Which C++ classes implement net::URLRequest::Delegate::OnResponseStarted(URLRequest* request, int net_error)? That is: classes deriving directly or indirectly from URLRequest::Delegate that declare or define OnResponseStarted with that parameter list. Exclude URLRequest::Delegate itself, and exclude classes outside that hierarchy even if they have a method with the same signature. Search the whole tree. Answer items: class names without namespaces.

Which C/C++/Objective-C++ files call the function IsCertStatusError? Count only real calls, not declarations, definitions, comments or strings. Search the whole tree. Answer items: repository-relative file paths.
